about: I am an Associate Consultant and custom application developer with {{experience}} of experience building enterprise applications, process-automation tools, data-processing workflows, and AI-enabled solutions.

I currently work within Forensic Technology, where I contribute to Python automation, REST API integrations, RelativityOne applications, Azure-based workflows, AI summarization and translation, application testing, deployment support, and production troubleshooting.

Before moving into forensic technology, I worked in the fintech domain across Python backend development and software quality engineering. My work included automating commission processing, developing financial-data utilities, creating Selenium-based file-download workflows, processing high-volume datasets, and building tools for bulk DBF, CSV, and Excel operations.
I enjoy solving operational problems that combine application development, automation, testing, data validation, user-experience improvement, and clear technical communication.
